children: 2021 ET - Japanese stocks are lower in early trade as uncertainty over the Iran war and the Fed policy outlook continues. Chip and metals stocks are leading the declines. Kioxia Holdings is down 7.9% and Mitsui Kinzoku is 5.8% lower. The dollar is at 153.50 yen, compared with Y154.09 as of Friday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are focusing on developments in the Middle East, crude oil prices and bond yields. The Nikkei Stock Average is down 1.6% at 62977.54. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)

1944 ET - Japanese stocks may decline as uncertainty over the Middle East conflict and the Fed policy outlook continues. Nikkei futures are down 1.4% at 63130 on the SGX. The dollar is at 153.58 yen, compared with Y154.09 as of Friday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are focusing on developments in the Iran war and crude oil prices. The Nikkei Stock Average fell 1.9% to 64011.34 on Friday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com)

1938 ET - The week ahead in Australian financial markets will be highlighted by further jawboning by the Reserve Bank of Australia. The top tier of the bank's management will testify before parliament on Friday after weeks of hawkish warnings about inflation, including comments that the community is "furious" about stubbornly high inflation. The worsening situation in the Middle East war and interest rate increases by other central banks will offer officials scope to add to their comments about inflation, setting the scene for a further interest rate increase at the end of this month. (james.glynn@wsj.com; X @JamesGlynnWSJ)
